scope: At 192x192 and 72 dpi, add /AntiAlias true to every shading dictionary of PDFs exported from the reduced SVG radial alpha masks and the 84-stamp SVG prototype. Compare alpha frames before and after in MuPDF and PDFium; compare to resvg for masks and pinned host-Mesa alpha for the stroke.
limitations: The prototype and runner inputs and dependencies follow pencil2-v14-svg-pdf-control.json; this postprocesses the exported PDF and is not a renderer change.
Only alpha at one resolution and the specified controls was compared. No claim about RGB, other readers, arbitrary transforms, saved notes, Android or production parity.
Identical pixels do not explain why the readers render the masks differently.
